title: Ambient Pressure Sensor High Error
detail_of_failure: A high voltage is sensed in the signal circuit of the ambient pressure sensor.
controller_action: Operates with ambient pressure as fixed value.
machine_effect: • Engine output is reduced. • Startability deteriorates.
related_information: • Input voltage from the ambient pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 37401 (V)) • Ambient pressure sensed by the ambient pressure sensor can be checked with monitoring function. (Code: 37400 (kPa)) • After the repair is done, check that the failure code is not shown with the operation that follows. Procedure: Turn the starting switch to the ON position.

steps.procedure: Check the wiring harness and connector. For details, see “Related Information to Troubleshooting”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”.
If failure code [CA352] or [CA386] is also shown at the same time, do the troubleshooting for that code first.

1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector AMB. AIR PRESSURE 3. Starting switch: ON If the failure code changes from [CA221] to [CA222], the sensor is defective. 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 3. Starting switch: ON
1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connectors ECM and AMB. AIR PRESSURE, and connect a T-adapter to one of them on the female side.

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (33) and (3), or between AMB. AIR PRESSURE (female) (1) and (3)

steps.cause: Hot short circuit in wiring harness
steps.procedure: 1. Starting switch: OFF 2. Disconnect the connector AMB. AIR PRESSURE 3. Connect a T-adapter to the female side of connector AMB. AIR PRES- SURE, or insert a T-adapter into the connector ECM. 4. Turn the starting switch to the ON position (with connector AMB. AIR PRESSURE disconnected).

measurements.point: Between ECM (female) (3) and (38), or between AMB. AIR PRESSURE (female) (3) and (2)

steps.procedure: If no failure is found by the previous checks, the engine controller is defective. (Because this is an internal defect, troubleshooting cannot be done.)
